hero.name: Aster
hero.ambition: Protect the place I call home

world.name: The Bellweather Downs

locations.name: Mossbell
locations.description: A small settlement of hearth fires, kitchen gardens, and familiar faces. Ashfall fever has reached its households; the old shrine is still a place to seek help. Ancestral rites require a witness or academy license; raising bodies and binding unwilling souls are prohibited.

locations.name: Alderwatch
locations.description: The region’s busy city gathers an academy, a guild market, and a sworn order behind its stone walls. Fever wards are filling, and scholars disagree over the cause. Ancestral rites require a witness or academy license; raising bodies and binding unwilling souls are prohibited.

locations.name: Fernbridge
locations.description: A riverside village where millers, ferrymen, and herbalists trade news. Families are sheltering travelers fleeing Ashfall fever. Willing ancestral rites and the study of the dead are permitted; coercion and grave theft remain crimes. Millers and neighbors reinforced the gate. Homes survived; the fields beyond it carry the flood’s damage.

locations.name: The Greywood
locations.description: Old trails connect both villages beneath a canopy of moss and copper leaves. Healing herbs grow here, alongside hungry beasts and abandoned camps. The nearest settlement’s law governs witnessed acts.

locations.name: The Hollow Archive
locations.description: An abandoned sanctuary beyond the forest holds sealed research and the memories of its former keepers. Licensed expeditions may study its ancestral records; disturbing remains without consent invites scrutiny.

locations.name: The Crownspine
locations.description: Wind-carved passes and abandoned mines cross the northern mountains. Guides keep a refuge beneath the high stones.

locations.name: The Sable Marsh
locations.description: Lanterns mark a boardwalk through deep reed beds. Apothecaries gather rare remedies beside drowned foundations.

locations.name: The Ivory Strand
locations.description: A harbor of salt-white sails, fisher families, and traders from distant provinces. New arrivals bring both opportunity and rumor.

locations.name: The Starwatch Tower
locations.description: A lonely observatory studies the stars and preserves knowledge beyond the city academy’s reach. Its keepers welcome careful learners.

locations.name: The Ember Encampment
locations.description: Travelers, scouts, and craftspeople share a guarded camp. A meal and an honest story can earn a place by the communal fire. Shared kitchens, a meeting hearth, and timber dwellings turn temporary shelter into a permanent community.

locations.name: The Brassward Crossing
locations.description: An ancient gateway controls the road into the uplands. Watchers record travelers, while weathered carvings hint at older promises.

locations.name: The High Lantern
locations.description: A fortified settlement overlooks the eastern roads. Orders and guilds offer an alternative to the city’s institutions.

locations.name: The Grove of Mercy
locations.description: A protected sanctuary shelters displaced families and teachers. Its doors remain open when other institutions fall silent.

world.laws: Local councils set their own rules. In Alderwatch, necromancy is regulated; in Mossbell, it is regulated; in Fernbridge, it is permitted. Authorities act on witnesses, reports, and discovered evidence. Willing ancestral contact, grave theft, and unwilling soul binding are treated as different acts.
world.culture: Wild groves are protected as common ground, and moon watchers teach respect for changing seasons.

festival.name: The First Moon Fair
festival.tradition: Neighbors exchange handmade gifts and tell stories of the year.

rumors: The academy in Alderwatch is seeking careful field observers, not only wealthy students.
A moonwise ranger near The Greywood can teach a refuge ritual without demanding allegiance.
Licensed ancestral research is attracting healers from distant villages.

mentors.name: Dame Mara Alder
mentors.description: A sworn protector offers training and an initiation founded on a visible oath of mercy and protection.

mentors.name: Scholar Tamsin
mentors.description: A physician teaches consensual ancestral rites and sponsors students studying the ruined archive.

mentors.name: Vey the Quiet
mentors.description: A discreet contact offers a test of stealth and judgment, with the terms disclosed before accepting.

companions.name: Mira
companions.goal: Earn a place in the Lantern Order without abandoning old friends.
memories: At seven, you helped turn an accusation into cooperation.
We began traveling together after growing up as friends.
You trusted me with the original covenant evidence.

companions.name: Orrin
companions.goal: Find a remedy for the fever and keep his family safe.
memories: You invited me to travel as a healer, without asking me to forget my family.

companions.name: Kest
companions.goal: Make the western road safe enough to visit a missing sibling.
values: Do not prey on desperate families
memories: You invited me onto the road while respecting my search for my sibling.
You respected my sibling’s fear while recovering the transport evidence.

legal.description: No local charges or known evidence.
